card.name: Words just before a number or noun in preparation steps
card.fires_on: Fires on the space or small word right before a quantity or fluid name in preparation steps ("bag of", "volume of"), and on "day" in "the next day" or "the following day".

modes.label: Before a fluid or amount
modes.description: The blank space or "of" just before a volume, needle size or diluent name in mixing instructions.

modes.label: Next day
modes.description: The word "day" ending "the next day" or "the following day" in missed-dose or activity instructions.
modes.example: If a dose is missed, take the next dose at the regularly scheduled time the next<< day>>.
